# Lodgify & GrowthBook | Potential future Setup
Date: 2026-10-08 | Duration: 29.540000915527344m

## Summary
GrowthBook is mainly used for feature flags and A/B tests, but redirect tests create mismatch errors and custom metrics require a database connection. Engineering implementation is challenging across multiple product modules handled by different engineers. Experiment results are exported to BigQuery and shared through Slack notifications, but easier sharing is needed. Experiments run weekly rather than daily and focus on conversion and retention, with experimentation expanding into more product areas and expected to grow next year. Enterprise adds governance, security, SSO, SAML, role-based access, support, onboarding, training, advanced experimentation features, no seat cap, and self-hosted, cloud-hosted, or EU cloud-hosted options. Enterprise contracts are annual and invoice-based, with installment options, while Pro is monthly and credit-card based. Marcel and Remy will provide feature comparisons and videos, while Anna will evaluate the value internally with engineers, business stakeholders, and budget owners.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Enterprise Features, Experimentation, Feature Flags, Payment Terms

## Action Items
**Marcel Geldner**  
Prepare comparison documents for GrowthBook editions (24:48)  
Share slides on hosting options and costs (26:00)  
Maintain communication with Lodgify team (28:09)  

**Rémy Marin**  
Provide detailed GrowthBook Enterprise features list (27:26)  

**Anna Smirnova**  
Review GrowthBook materials internally (24:48)
